To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a 2. 5D convolutional attention network with a hardness weighted loss function can achieve high segmentation performance in the challenging task of vestibular schwammoma segmentation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the segmentation of VS tumors from MRI.
the development of an accurate and robust method to segment VS tumors in T2-weighted MRI.
the development of a novel 2.5-D convolutional neural network for automatic segmentation of VS tumors from T2-weighted MRI.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our method can automatically segment VS tumors with a high accuracy, robustness and efficiency.
our method can accurately segment the VS tumor and is robust to the through-plane resolution.

we have introduced a 2. 5 D convolutional neural network able to exploit the in-plane and through plane resolutions of standard of care imaging protocol, and we have introduced a supervised attention module that learns to focus on small targets.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a novel 2.5d CNN with attention module and hardness-weighted Dice Loss for the segmentation of VS tumors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the 2.5-Dimensional (2.5D) convolution can be a powerful tool in medical image analysis and can outperform its 2D counterpart.
2.5-Dimensional CNNs can be trained on 2-Dimensional data with through-plane resolution and can outperform 2D and full 3D networks.
the proposed 2D CNN is able to exploit the through-plane resolution and the proposed hardness-weighted loss can boost the training of the 2D CNN.
